column1: # The stand manifests and their order (stand.md «Manifests»): the runner sets them up by the command manifest-put one by one, in the order of n, after the
# store is ready and before the first @start; the manifests reference each other, so their files do not give the order. stand.md refers to this form.
# n: the position of the installation, 1, 2, … without gaps. manifest: the name of the manifest. file: the manifest file, a repository-relative path.
# beside: a repository-relative directory whose whole content the stand puts next to the copy of the manifest under the same paths (the files of
# console.shell and console.files, which the installation reads next to the manifest file); - — nothing.
